title: Large Scale Language Modeling in Automatic Speech Recognition
review_status: full-text audit complete; n-gram LM/ASR deployment setup, WER outcomes, training corpora, and evidence boundary checked
sections_checked: Voice Search data and model-size experiment
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2012-10-31; venue not verified
evidence_note: Industrial statistical n-gram language-model study; relative WER gains 6–10% on tested Google ASR configurations. Voice Search used 230B query words. Internal proprietary workloads and integration details limit independent replication; not a modern neural foundation-model evaluation.

title: Neural DrugNet
review_status: full-text audit complete; model ensemble, shared-task tasks, validation/test metrics, and acknowledged metric issue checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2018-08-31; venue not verified
evidence_note: Ensembles pretrained word-LSTM and character-trigram LSTM for medication/social-media classification; second place in one shared task. Task 2 test F1 0.505; Task 4 test F1 0.859. Authors acknowledge Task 2 development initially used accuracy rather than F1.

title: Teaching Pretrained Models with Commonsense Reasoning: A Preliminary KB-Based Approach
review_status: full-text audit complete; ConceptNet question construction, downstream few-shot results, five-run averages, and scope checked
sections_checked: ConceptNet filtering and generated logical forms
evidence_note: ConceptNet-derived synthetic QA refinement improved BERT from 34.94% to 42.54% and XLNet from 25.04% to 43.60% on 100-example CommonsenseQA (five runs); full-data gains about two points. Evidence is task/model-generation specific.

title: The Economic Trade-offs of Large Language Models: A Case Study
review_status: full-text audit complete; single-brand annotation design, ENCS calculation, extrapolation method, and time/scale limitations checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2023-06-08; venue not verified
evidence_note: Real agent usefulness ratings in one retail brand; economic result can favor cheaper distilled GPT-2 despite lower answer quality. Some configurations' usefulness is extrapolated from perplexity; prices and cost estimates are historical/time-sensitive.

title: Why does in-context learning fail sometimes? Evaluating in-context learning on open and closed questions
review_status: full-text audit complete; 160-item open-question setup, six-grader results, same-model closed-question replication, and direction reversal checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-07-02; venue not verified
evidence_note: For GPT-4 1106, context similarity is negatively associated with score on the 160-item open-form set but positively associated on two closed-form datasets evaluated using the same model/framework. Relevant context does not universally hurt; custom small open-question sample and grader noise limit generalization.

title: Exploring the Role of Reasoning Structures for Constructing Proofs in Multi-Step Natural Language Reasoning with Large Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; proof-graph method, three datasets, baselines, metrics, significance claim, and English/API-cost limitations checked
evidence_note: Reports improved evidence/proof F1 and graph similarity over listed baselines on three English natural-language reasoning datasets; paired-test significance claimed. Does not test math reasoning or other languages and incurs high token/API costs.

title: From Model Design to Organizational Design: Complexity Redistribution and Trade-Offs in Generative AI
review_status: full-text audit complete; conceptual GAS framework and use of external empirical examples distinguished from a directly tested intervention
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2 dated 2026-05-15; venue not verified
evidence_note: Conceptual organizational framework synthesizes outside evidence; it does not experimentally test GAS as one intervention. Useful for hypothesis generation but not a direct productivity/accuracy effect estimate.

title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
review_status: full-text audit complete; human verification, benchmark spot-check, curriculum cognition results, matched-budget SFT and multimodal outcomes checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4; version header inspected; venue not verified
evidence_note: 12 qualified annotators; Fleiss kappa 0.84; 98.4% sampled-item correctness. Reports 46% exact match for a strong open model on curriculum cognition; ~2,300 curriculum examples outperform equally sized general-data subsets on specified tests. Results are Chinese K-12/domain/model specific.

title: Fluency and Faithfulness in Human and Machine Literary Translation
review_status: full-text audit complete; corpus/method, raw and length-controlled associations, source differences, and metric limitations checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-05-14; venue not verified
evidence_note: Large literary translation sample; raw Spearman association -0.0374 and length-controlled partial rho -0.0827, with source-specific variation and TranslateGemma near zero/slightly positive. Fluency is POS original-likeness and faithfulness is COMET-KIWI; not human evaluation. Translation metadata incomplete.

title: Bright: A Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
review_status: citation follow-up full-text audit complete; retrieval benchmark scope, RAG comparison, and oracle-evidence contrast checked
sections_checked: reasoning-aware retrieval and RAG downstream case
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4 dated 2025-03-26; venue not verified
evidence_note: BRIGHT has 1,384 reasoning-intensive retrieval queries; stronger/reasoning-aware retrieval and retrieved documents can improve QA, while oracle evidence improves more. Related counterevidence to a broad claim that relevant context harms performance, but it is not a replication of open-vs-closed ICL effects.
